verification_note: The dispatcher mechanism was proven live on 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26, the first autonomous lane output was merged by the merge-by-gate rule as pull request #459, the reviewer findings on that output were applied afterwards, and the shortlist followed as pull request #460; main CI is green again after the gitleaks exception for OpenCode automation ids (runs 45737235261 and 45739163505). Run #16 found the stalled sales lane cause in its own session export (the prepared text missed the price the owner rule requires), run #17 found the third mechanical failure (the worker launcher could not find the CLI) and the operator lane then sent the first message itself (verified live at 2026-11-26T03:56:27Z, comment issuecomment-7182154484), run #18 found the launcher cause (Start-Process cannot run a .cmd shim with redirected output; the worker now starts opencode.exe, proven with a launched --version), and run #19 proved the chain end to end (a self-test answered SELFTEST_OK on the nvidia account, and the 12:25 slot opened a real lane session ses_de9af8506ffewqDNLEA5SX9dqf). Runs #21 and #22 saw the reviewer refuse pull request #461 and the scoped workers deadlock on the missing gate, which the operator lane broke with 36c74d4c; run #23 applied the second review round as cc38a85c and the third as 8d855f10 (the generator owns the role documents and the table, the verifier reads --no-renames and refuses empty diffs and ambiguous paths, and every generated agent file denies the subagent action). Runs #24 and #25 built the manager loop: the watchdog reads the lane session heartbeat and counts the child sessions a lane dispatched (the ceo lane ran 5 and the engineer lane 4 on one key, the request multiplication that ends in HTTP 429), and the dispatcher moved out of the harness into scripts/dev/agent-fleet/dispatch.ts. Run #26 merged the whole head as 6df8ddb5 after seven of seven CI checks and Sonar were green; the reviewer agent could not finish a pass (HTTP 429 on the NVIDIA key, free usage limit on the console provider), so the owner approved the merge on the operator review plus the green CI. Three lane sessions then ran at once on three different keys: slot-nvidia-1/engineer-20261126-1233, slot-nvidia-2/ceo-20261126-1233 and slot-nvidia-3/marketer-20261126-1233. The live funnel over the last 24 hours held page.view 118 events / 63 browsers, pair.view 67 / 47, install.view 54 / 53, plan.view 11 / 10, buy.click 0 / 0, every row anonymous, with 0 browsers that acted. Run #27 found the loop's own gap: the dispatcher held a key by its process table, and a session the service kept alive without its launcher process let a second session start on the same key; the dispatcher now reads the session list as well, the duplicate session was stopped, and the fleet runs one session per key. Run #28 closed the engineer ticket: the lane merged its split of the funnel ticket into main as 0ad6aa69 with the reply engineer-reply-20261126-1233.md, and the watchdog had released the ticket because the local checkout was behind the remote; the loop now reads the answers from origin/main, so a lane that lands its work first is never sent to redo it. The proof of run #26 is docs/proof/2026-11-26-survival-run-26.md, the proof of run #27 is docs/proof/2026-11-26-survival-run-27.md and the proof of run #28 is docs/proof/2026-11-26-survival-run-28.md. Run 2026-11-27 08:24 UTC found and fixed the earliest real checkout drop-off (sign-in loop before PayPal); prices were contradictory (/bulan under one-payment copy) and are now explicit. No owner-only path moved. No revenue moved: still 0 settled orders.
